dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Gigi has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to have a tense body and tucked tail. When returning to kennel, Gigi is observed to balk on leash. This behavior is able to be redirected with coaxing and mild leash pressure. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Gigi
